content:
This article lists **plans** for Power Armor Mods in *Fallout 76*.

Plans are found throughout Appalachia and surrounding expansion areas, both in containers and out in the open. Some plans can be purchased from vendors or received as quest rewards. Certain plans are random, while others respawn at fixed locations. Plans that appear inside of building interiors have a chance of spawning every time the building is re-entered. All plans weigh 0.25.

Junk items are also used to craft new power armor and power armor modifications at a Power Armor Station. Similar to standard armors, finding Plans unlock further modifications at the Power Armor Station. There are fixed locations for modification boxes to potentially spawn, although the ones that do are randomized, and certain vendors may sell armor modifications.

Power armor modifications with gameplay attributes can be applied to the helmet, torso, arms, and legs of any set of armor. These include modifications such as increased Carry Weight, the addition of a Jet Pack, or highlighting enemies with a Targeting HUD. Additionally, there are cosmetic modifications such as paint and skins which alter armor appearance but do not have an effect on function. Helmets also have Headlamp modifications which alter brightness and color of the light produced.

The following legend gives broad information regarding where the plans can be found. Please visit individual articles for specific information.
